$comment: The Pumpkin release the benchmark runs: an official build from the project's GitHub release,
which is how Pumpkin's quick start tells people to run it. `sha256` is from the release's
`checksums.sha256`, and the harness checks every download against it. `commit` is the commit
the tag points at. Each asset is a release build; the plain x86-64 one is used rather than
`X64-v3`, because Node.js and Bedrock Dedicated Server ship one generic x86-64 build too.
